extDescription.message: Learn Japanese while you watch: highlights new JLPT words in Netflix or custom subtitles and saves them as Anki flashcards.
extDescription.description: Chrome Web Store summary; at most 132 characters.

htmlLang.description: BCP 47 language tag for the lang attribute of extension pages.

definitionLanguage.description: Language of dictionary definitions: "en" for English, "zh" for Chinese.

toastNoNewWord.message: No new words in this subtitle

toastScreenshotFailed.message: Saved without a screenshot. To capture this tab, click the Immersive Memorize icon, or allow access to all sites in Settings.

pickerDropPrompt.message: Choose a subtitle file or drop it here

pickerUnsupportedFile.message: Choose an SRT, VTT, ASS or SSA file.

pickerNoCues.message: No subtitles were found in this file.

popupEmptyHint.message: Watch something in Japanese and press $1 to save the highlighted word.

popupCustomSubtitlesDescription.message: Use your own SRT, VTT or ASS file with any video on this page.

popupPinSubtitlesHint.message: Use this if subtitles are misplaced or hidden by the player.

popupPageNotSupported.message: Immersive Memorize can't run on this page.

popupNoVideo.message: No video was found on this page.

popupNoVideoNeedsAccess.message: No video was found. If the player is embedded from another site, allow access to all sites and try again.

confirmDeleteAll.message: Delete all $1 cards? This can't be undone.

cardsEmptyHint.message: While watching Japanese video, press $1 to save the highlighted word.

vocabularyDescription.message: Choose the JLPT levels to learn. New words from these levels are highlighted in subtitles.

settingsDescription.message: Settings sync across browsers signed in to the same Chrome profile.

settingsHotkeyHint.message: Click the box, then press a letter. Pressing it while a word is highlighted saves that word as a card.

settingsScreenshots.message: Save a screenshot with each card

settingsScreenshotsHint.message: Captures the video frame when you save a word. Chrome asks for access to all sites; without it, screenshots work on tabs where you clicked the toolbar icon. If screenshots come out black, turn off hardware acceleration in Chrome's system settings.

settingsScreenshotsNoAccess.message: Screenshots will work on tabs where you click the Immersive Memorize icon.

exportFormatHintAnkiHtml.message: Furigana in Anki's 漢字[かんじ] format, the saved word in bold and screenshots embedded. Anki recognizes the fields automatically.

exportFormatHintPlainText.message: Text only, without furigana or screenshots. Opens in any spreadsheet.

exportFormatHintRichText.message: HTML that keeps furigana as ruby text and colors the saved word, for apps that display HTML.

settingsEverywhereHint.message: Starts automatically wherever you browse. Chrome asks for access to all sites.

settingsSitesHint.message: Starts automatically on these sites. Elsewhere, click the toolbar icon to start it. Patterns use Chrome's format, such as *://*.example.com/*.

settingsAccessDenied.message: Chrome didn't grant access, so nothing was changed.

settingsBackupHint.message: Cards are stored only in this browser. Export a backup to keep them safe or move them to another computer. Importing adds the cards that aren't here yet.

settingsBackupInvalid.message: This file is not an Immersive Memorize backup.

settingsDebugHint.message: Writes detailed logs to the browser console, for troubleshooting.

aboutPrivacy.message: Your cards and screenshots stay in this browser, and settings sync through your Chrome profile. Nothing is sent to any other server.

aboutCreditJlpt.message: JLPT word lists and Chinese definitions, by egg rolls
